entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: In the depths of their hearts, all humans[n]have a self that differs from the one[n]they're normally aware of.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: It's like a mask that protects their heart[n]when they confront the external world.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: The power to pull that out willingly and[n]use it in battle is called a Persona ability.

entries.speaker: Caroline

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: This is essentially the same as the[n]concept that is commonly referred[n]to as the "collective unconscious."

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: People typically avert their eyes from[n]that world, and the darkness in their[n]hearts may float there.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: When one of those takes form, it becomes[n]a Shadow.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: However, the Shadows you see in Palaces[n]are trapped by distortion and made into[n]slaves by its ruler.

entries.speaker: Justine

entries.speaker: Caroline

entries.en: The Palace Shadows return to their[n]natural form during battle in order[n]to unleash their full potential.

entries.speaker: Justine

entries.speaker: Justine

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Their appearance as gods and demons[n]may be related to them being the image[n]of power all mankind shares.

entries.speaker: Justine

entries.speaker: Justine

entries.speaker: Justine

entries.en: A Disaster Shadow refers to an aberrant[n]Shadow that you may encounter from[n]time to time.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Our theory is that they are ordinary[n]Shadows, transformed by an influx of[n]negative emotions from the masses.
